FIP.thesis_summary: Signed definitive sale of Long Ridge Energy & Power to a MARA Holdings subsidiary for ~$1.52B (announced 4/30/26) closes in Q3 2026, eliminating $1.16B of Long Ridge debt at close plus ~$300M of net proceeds repaying parent debt; the deleveraged remain-co (Transtar rail, Jefferson Terminal, Repauno) re-rates toward ~$9 recovery value from $4.44. Verified live 2026-07-03: no FERC change-of-control order yet (June FERC meeting passed without it; management guides approval mid-Q3), PJM market monitor's 5/29 FERC filing is a conditioning request not a block, contractual outside date 2026-11-30 with a 7-month extension option. Balance-sheet track is active in parallel: 7/1/26 Jefferson took a $230M Jefferies bridge loan (matures 6/30/27) repaying the Series 2024B Beaumont bonds at maturity, and 6/29/26 FIP closed the $45M Tidewater bolt-on via term-loan upsize.
FIP.kill_risk: The FERC change-of-control order has NOT issued as of 2026-07-03 and the PJM independent market monitor's demanded condition (commit Long Ridge capacity/energy to PJM markets) strikes at MARA's core rationale of powering its own behind-the-meter data-center load — if FERC imposes it, MARA could contest, renegotiate, or run out the clock, pushing close from the Q3 guide toward the 11/30/26 outside date (extendable 7 months) or killing the deal. A delayed close compresses the remain-co refi runway now that Jefferson leans on a 1-year bridge maturing 6/30/27. Also note the $9 target embeds management run-rate segment EBITDA (~$250M+); on trailing run-rate the same math yields ~$5-6.

Definitive agreement (4/30/26) at fixed ~$1.52B; Q3 2026 guided close (FERC approval guided mid-Q3; outside date 11/30/26 + 7-mo extension), pending FERC/HSR/STB + MARA noteholder consent. SC 13D/A + Form 4s filed 7/2 (holder/insider activity, not deal-status). At live $4.44: R/R = (9-4.44)/(4.44-3.90) ~ 8.4:1.

VRDN.thesis_summary: Binary FDA-approval special situation on veligrotug (Lumvoa) for thyroid eye disease. The event RESOLVED WON: FDA approved Lumvoa on 2026-06-26, four days ahead of the 2026-06-30 PDUFA date, with immediate commercial launch (company 8-K accepted 2026-06-26, EDGAR CIK 0001590750; Business Wire 2026-06-26). Stock re-rated from the $16.31 setup to $19.40. The pre-event asymmetry ($8 rejection floor / $35 win target) no longer exists — remaining upside to $35 is ordinary launch-execution risk versus Amgen's incumbent Tepezza, not defined-risk event edge. Seat's edge is spent.
VRDN.kill_risk: Not applicable as an event kill — the catalyst fired favorably and irreversibly (clean approval, launch underway; post-approval EDGAR shows only routine Form 4s and an SC 13G). The honest residual risk applies only to any still-held seat: the gap from $19.40 to the old $35 win target is commercial-execution upside against entrenched Tepezza (payer access, launch ramp, competitive pricing), which is ordinary equity risk outside this sleeve's mandate.

EYPT.thesis_summary: EyePoint's DURAVYU Phase 3 LUGANO wet-AMD topline is a genuine, unfired single-name binary. Trial is fully enrolled (enrollment completed Jul 2025), no topline exists as of Jul 3 2026, and three consecutive positive DSMC reviews (latest May 14 2026) reviewed masked SAFETY only — so the efficacy non-inferiority outcome vs aflibercept remains a true open binary. Downside is backstopped by a real balance sheet ($222.5M cash+STI at Q1'26, effectively no debt, no going-concern), though the specific $5.50 floor imputes pipeline residual above bare cash (~$2.65/sh). Spread has not closed (~$13.98 vs ~$37.50 win target).
EYPT.resolution_driver: Phase 3 clinical topline readout (DURAVYU LUGANO wet-AMD, primary BCVA endpoint) — company-run trial data, not an FDA action
EYPT.kill_risk: Timing softness on the load-bearing date: the company only guides "mid-2026" (a window, not a committed date); the 2026-07-31 "hard" date is a sell-side interpolation. Enrollment completed ~Jul 2025 and the primary endpoint is at 56 weeks, so last-patient-last-visit lands ~Aug-Sep 2026 — the readout can slip into Q3 (sell-side already models ~August). Second-order: the 60% win prob is NOT efficacy-de-risked — DSMC reviewed masked safety only, so Phase 3 non-inferiority on BCVA is genuinely unresolved; a miss would test the softness of the $5.50 floor (bare cash is only ~$2.65/sh vs a 52-wk low of $9.40).

LZM.thesis_summary: 84%-owned, permitted, FS-complete Kabanga Ni-Cu-Co sulfide project (NPV8 $1.58B at the FS deck, ~$1.11B spot-marked) sits inside a ~$343M mcap; the resolving event is a Standard Chartered-run strategic-partner investment (term-sheet stage, multiple offers, Reuters-reported bidder, possible asset-level change of control) plus SocGen-led project debt culminating in FID/financial close, company-targeted within calendar 2026 (was mid-2026, now tracking late-2026). A binding partner cheque re-rates toward risked SoP — but at spot nickel the R:R is ~1:1 vs 2.7:1 on the deck.
LZM.kill_risk: The "concludes shortly" strategic process may not produce a BINDING cheque in 2026: the mid-2026 FID target has already passed unfired, Seeking Alpha (6/25) and the Q1 6-K confirm no binding financing terms, Taurus bridge covenant waivers signal fragility, serial equity raises (~$4.00 Nov-25, $4.40 Apr-26) show the equity tranche is the crux, and spot nickel 12% below the FS deck weakens bidder pricing. A slip to 2027 and/or a punitive dilutive bridge or an asset-level change of control that strands holdco value would break both the timeline and the non-contractual $2.60 floor.

DDL.thesis_summary: Definitive SPA (Feb 5, 2026) to sell Dingdong's China business to Meituan's Two Hearts unit for US$717M cash plus a right to sweep up to US$280M of BVI cash pre-close; shareholder approval done (AGM Mar 27); sole substantive open gate is SAMR anti-monopoly clearance. Company has committed (Feb 10 6-K) to return not less than 90% of post-close cash via buybacks/dividends — roughly $3.9/ADS returned against a $1.975 tape, with total post-close cash ~$4.3/ADS on 216.6M ADS. SPA carries a 12-month long-stop (~Feb 5, 2027, extendable) and a US$75M buyer break fee if antitrust clearance fails despite company cooperation. Deal verified unfired: Q1 6-K (May 22) states verbatim the transaction has not been completed; no clearance/closing announcement through Jul 6, 2026.
DDL.kill_risk: Two-part residual: (1) SAMR review of dominant instant-retail player Meituan absorbing the #1 fresh-grocery e-tailer runs long or attaches conditions, pushing past the Feb-2027 long-stop where the deal becomes terminable (the $75M break fee ≈ only $0.35/ADS consolation); (2) the >=90% capital return is a stated INTENTION, not a binding covenant — terms are set post-close by a founder-controlled dual-class board, so even on a clean close the cash could be returned slowly/partially and the stock re-rate to a holdco-discount rather than the ~$3.9 cash value. Market pricing at $1.975 (below even consolidated net cash of $2.15/ADS) says the tape already charges for both.

THRM.thesis_summary: Stock-for-stock Reverse Morris Trust in which Gentherm ACQUIRES Modine's Performance Technologies (SpinCo): THRM issues new shares equal to 40% of the pro forma fully diluted count to former SpinCo holders; existing THRM holders retain 60% and receive NO cash and NO fixed consideration — there is no spread to clip. The live pending event is deal close itself, guided Q4 CY2026 (special-meeting date still blank in the July 2, 2026 S-4; Outside Date 2027-03-31, extendable to 2027-06-30 for regulatory only). HSR antitrust was already cleared via early termination 2026-03-26; remaining gates are the Gentherm shareholder vote (Share Issuance + Charter Amendment), the IRS private-letter ruling, and consummation of the Separation/Distribution with SpinCo financing (Gentherm's own $550M revolver was refinanced 2026-06-29). Upside is a post-close re-rating on pro forma ~$2.6B revenue / ~$322M EBITDA (incl. $25M synergies), not an event-clipped convergence.
THRM.kill_risk: Even if the merger closes on schedule, THRM common captures no contractual value at close — the entire payoff is a market re-rating of a bulked-up, lower-margin cyclical auto supplier, and at the live tape (~$33.91) the pro forma company already trades at ~6.8x gross EV/EBITDA on the $322M synergy-inclusive guide, roughly THRM's own standalone multiple — i.e., the re-rating is substantially priced. Residuals: (1) exchange-ratio adjustment risk — if the IRS ruling's Overlap Shareholder counting falls short of the ~50.5% Section 355(e) threshold, the ratio adjusts up toward 50.5% for SpinCo holders (economically offset by design via reduced SpinCo Cash Distribution / potential Gentherm Special Dividend, but a dilution-optics overhang); (2) the spent HSR clearance respawns if close slips past ~2027-03-26 (new filing required 12 months after early termination); (3) no floor — downside is the standalone cyclical trading range (52-wk low $27), market-dependent, with $470.7M pro forma debt post-close.

THRM.dossier_note: Re-underwritten from the S-4 filed 2026-07-02 (joint proxy/prospectus), the 2026-06-29 credit-agreement 8-K, and the live tape. STRUCTURE: RMT — Modine spins PT into SpinCo, SpinCo merges into THRM merger sub; Exchange Ratio designed so former SpinCo holders own 40% FD post-close (THRM holders 60%); THRM holders receive nothing at close. Only the GENTHERM vote is required (Share Issuance + Charter Amendment proposals) — no Modine shareholder vote, contra the skeptic's 'dual votes' claim. Conditions: THRM vote (date blank), IRS PLR (pending; also gates the Overlap Shareholder determination), Separation/Distribution consummation, SpinCo financing; HSR done 2026-03-26 (early termination), but a new HSR filing is required if close slips ~12 months past it (~2027-03-26) — note Outside Date 2027-03-31 sits right at that boundary. ARITHMETIC: THRM ~30.7M shares ($1.040B mkt cap / $33.91) -> ~51.1M FD post-close (60% retention). Combined guide ~$2.6B rev / ~$322M EBITDA incl. $25M synergies; S-4 pro forma debt $470.7M (3/31/26 basis; up to $290M additional may be incurred incl. SpinCo Cash Distribution). Gross-EV check (ignoring PF cash): at tape 33.91 -> EV ~$2.20B = ~6.8x; at target 40 -> ~$2.52B = ~7.8x; board's 44 -> ~$2.72B = ~8.4x, above the sell-side band (~39.4-40.6) — corrected to 40. Floor 27 = 52-wk low; board's 30 had no contractual basis. Corrected R:R at tape = 6.09/6.91 = ~0.88 (board 2.87 reproduced arithmetically from 44/30/33.62 but both inputs fail live verification). Exchange-ratio adjustment mechanism (355(e) ~50.5% threshold incl. Overlap Shareholders) is disclosed as 'not expected to be triggered'; if triggered, SpinCo Cash Distribution shrinks and pre-merger THRM holders may receive a Gentherm Special Dividend preserving nominal economics. NET: deal alive and progressing (S-4 filed, financing done, HSR spent) but this is a re-rating equity bet, not a defined-risk arb — consistent with the weekly skeptic's REFUTED finding; corrected axes show sub-1 R:R at the current tape.

ZYME.thesis_summary: Idiosyncratic single-agency FDA binary. Aug 25, 2026 PDUFA target action date on Jazz's Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma sBLA — Priority Review, Breakthrough Therapy, Real-Time Oncology Review, pivotal HERIZON-GEA-01 positive (PFS 12.4 vs 8.1 mo, HR ~0.63, P<.0001). US GEA approval triggers a contractual, still-unpaid $250M milestone from Jazz to Zymeworks (~$3.40/sh on ~73.6M sh) plus royalty re-rating. Confirmed unfired at 2026-07-06 (50 days out), no CRL, no slip.
ZYME.kill_risk: Single FDA binary and it is the drug's FIRST-EVER GEA (new tumor type, NOT a label expansion — Ziihera's only prior US approval is 2L biliary tract cancer, Nov 2024). A CRL / RTOR pushback / label-restriction tail survives despite the strong Phase 3 + Breakthrough. On a CRL the $250M milestone is delayed (not lost), but the ~$19 floor is softer than a fortress-cash read: the approved-royalty leg it leans on is encumbered by a $250M Royalty Pharma royalty-backed note (executed 3/2/26, non-recourse, repaid from ~30% of worldwide Ziihera royalties). Added overlay: ZYME committed ~$929M cash + CVR to acquire Theravance (closing 2H26), so ZYME's own balance sheet is a moving target through the FDA window.

LBTYK.thesis_summary: Two-stage Benelux self-restructuring against a chronic ~60% holdco discount: (1) binding, EC-cleared (unconditional, 25-Jun-2026) buy-in of Vodafone's 50% of VodafoneZiggo for EUR 1.0B cash + 10% of new Ziggo Group (VodafoneZiggo+Telenet), close guided July 2026, UNFIRED as of 07-06; (2) Ziggo Group Euronext-Amsterdam listing with ~90% distributed to Liberty Global holders, guided 'in 2027' (H2-2027 color on the 1-May call), leadership installed Sep 1 to prep it. The spin delivers Ziggo equity (~$12-14/sh gross by deal-implied math) directly into holders' hands, bypassing the holdco discount, with VMO2 50% + a $3.4B-FMV Liberty Growth book (alone ~93% of the $3.67B cap) left in the stub. Spin leg is voluntary and vote/window-contingent — a stage-in special situation, not a closed spread.
LBTYK.kill_risk: The spin/listing is voluntary — subject to a not-yet-scheduled shareholder vote (6/23 AGM was routine only: directors/auditors/say-on-pay), SEC registration, and an open 2027 market window for a ~5x-levered Benelux telco (de-leverage roadmap only reaches ~4.5x by 2028). Nothing contractually compels it: Vodafone's remedy if no spin within 18 months of close is a right to sell its 10% to a third party — pressure, not compulsion. A weak listing tape pushes the event into 2028 with dead money at the holdco discount, and even on completion the retained stub (VMO2 + Growth) can keep trading at a deep discount, capping realized value well below $18. Floor $9.5 is a discount-persistence mark, not a cash backstop.
